description.zh-CN: 三日凌空下的文明观测站。比较有限三体轨迹，在暗铜观测台归档资料、静默值守并开始一段专注。
description.en: A civilization observatory beneath three suns, with an interactive finite three-body model, desktop tools and a local focus timer.

concept.world: A monumental civilization observatory, three suns and an austere bronze observation instrument.
concept.mood: Cinematic scale, bone-white typography, dark copper, quiet negative space and measured light.
concept.type: Bundled serif display lettering paired with deliberate system text and tabular numbers.
concept.motion: A bounded 30 fps finite numerical orbit demonstration over static scene art; freeze and reduced motion are respected.

metaphors.tidy-files.run: 文明归档: archive loose desktop files
metaphors.tidy-files.undo: 恢复档案: undo the last archive
metaphors.quit-apps.run: 静默值守: ask unprotected apps to quit normally
metaphors.focus: 守望: a recoverable local 25-minute focus timer

requirements.verification: overview, responsive captures and demo interactions

requirements.implementation: tidy-files, open-path, quit-apps SDK bindings with plain subtitles
requirements.verification: demo state fixtures; built-in behavior covered separately

requirements.implementation: 25-minute focus timer with deadline storage, pause and reset
